name: chat-to-preview-layout
title: Chat to Preview Layout
description: A two-up split where the chat panel shrinks and the preview panel expands, to show an agent building something. Both panels hold generic placeholder content. On a tall frame the split stacks vertically (chat on top).
useWhen: Showing an AI agent at work: the conversation starts as the subject, then yields the frame to what it produced.
You need a two-column split whose ratio animates, with no cut.
avoidWhen: Both columns should stay the same size: use a plain flex row.
The change between the two states is a cut rather than a squeeze: use a transition.
author: Remocn
